P1.1.text: Allient Inc. | Solutions for Motion, Controls & Power

P1.2.text: Allient is a global leader in precision solutions for motion, controls, and power quality, serving OEMs and end users across a range of industries.

P1.3.text: Our Allied Motion Technology Pillar offers solutions including component parts and integrated systems that make movement possible, such as precision motors and drives.

P1.4.text: Our Allient Controls Technology Pillar is focused on industrial automation, control systems, and solutions that streamline functionality throughout countless applications.

P1.5.text: Our Allient Power Technology Pillar brings solutions that concentrate on the consistency and reliability issues associated with industrial power conversion, such as harmonics or transients in waveforms.

P1.6.text: Allient is a global leader in precision solutions for Motion, Controls, and Power Quality, serving OEMs and end users across Aerospace, Defense, Medical, Industrial, Vehicles, and more.

P1.7.text: We help clients overcome challenges and seize opportunities with reliable, high-performance technologies. As one unified team, we combine motion, controls, and power to deliver the most robust and high-value systems—driving progress and making a global impact.

P2.2.text: Allient is a global leader in engineered solutions that power the world's most advanced technologies. Our expertise spans motion, controls, and power.

P2.3.text: Allient is a global leader in engineered solutions that power the world’s most advanced technologies. Our expertise spans Motion, Controls, and Power, supporting mission-critical applications across Aerospace, Defense, Medical, Industrial, Vehicles, and other demanding applications.

P2.4.text: We partner with OEMs and system integrators to solve the most complex challenges and unlock new possibilities with reliable, high-performance systems. As a unified team operating across multiple global locations, we integrate our core disciplines to deliver tailored solutions that drive real results and global impact.

P2.5.text: we changed our name from Allied Motion Technologies to Allient (Allient Nexus Technologies) to reflect the expanded breadth of capabilities and products we offer that go beyond motion. This is a truly exciting time for Allient and made possible by our outstanding employees, partners and customer base.

P2.6.text: Since the change, the brands within our organization have continued to provide motion solutions under their individual brand identity. As part of our continued growth journey, these names and branding will be retired and changed to Allient and their location name based on where each facility is located.

P2.7.text: Over the coming months, you will see updates being made to our existing websites and branding to reflect this new direction.
